units.title: Domain A: Fundamentals of Tourism Management

outcomes.text: Tell travel, tourism, tourist and hospitality apart.
Explore how tourism evolved and its role in economic, social and cultural development.
Identify forms of tourism such as leisure, business and adventure, and why people travel.
Analyse positive and negative effects of tourism on communities, economies and environments.
Discuss why sustainability matters in tourism, including responsible travel and protecting cultural and natural resources.

units.title: Domain B: Tourism and Travel Index

outcomes.text: Define the Tourism and Travel Index.
Identify key traits of an enabling environment as a pillar of the index.
Discuss features of travel and tourism policy and enabling conditions as a pillar.
Recognise why infrastructure is a pillar of the index.
List travel and tourism demand drivers as a pillar.
Analyse travel and tourism sustainability features as a pillar.

units.title: Domain C: Ethical & Sustainable Tourism

outcomes.text: Show basic skill in the SDGs for responsible tourism.
Define the SDGs and state the 17 goals.
Describe responsible tourism and its principles.
Predict how a traveller's choices affect environment, communities and heritage.
Plan ways as a traveller to support at least one SDG through responsible travel.

units.title: Domain D: Tourist Psychology

outcomes.text: Examine psychological factors in travel motivation: intrinsic, extrinsic, interests and needs.
Group common travel motives such as relaxation, exploration, adventure, culture and social contact.
Evaluate how demographics, personality and past experience shape travel motivation.
Tell the stages of the travel decision process apart: need, search, evaluation, purchase and review.
Analyse personal, social, marketing and review factors that influence each stage.
Explore how online platforms, social media and apps changed travel decisions.
Understand the role of culinary and food tourism in tourist psychology.
Identify tourist attractions in Pakistan, especially heritage sites, and their cultural and historical value.

units.title: Domain E: Technology & Tourism

outcomes.text: Use mobile technology and apps, social media and digital marketing platforms, and expect future trends.
Assess how mobile technology and social media improve destination marketing.
Analyse how digital marketing targets audience segments and shapes traveller behaviour.

units.title: Domain F: Future Challenges and Opportunities

outcomes.text: Identify current trends, challenges and disruptions in tourism.
Do market research on market dynamics, consumer behaviour and competitors.
Explore how global events, economic shifts and geopolitics affect tourism.

outcomes.text: Understand legal frameworks, regulations and compliance in tourism.
Build ethical decision-making in customer dealings, community engagement and environmental impact.
Appreciate diverse cultures and promote respectful, inclusive practice.

Understand social responsibility in tourism: community well-being, equity and reducing harm.
Research responsible and sustainable practices that cut environmental impact and help local communities.

units.title: Domain D: Tourist Psychology

outcomes.text: Classify traveller types such as adventure seekers, culture lovers, luxury travellers and nature lovers.
Examine personality traits linked to traveller types, such as openness and risk-taking.
Analyse how age, gender and socio-economic status relate to traveller personality types.
Explain psychographic segmentation in travel and how it shapes marketing.
Analyse changing traveller personality trends driven by society, technology and global events.
Explain how technology and social media shape the tourism experience.

Group destinations for social media marketing using visuals, storytelling and engagement.
Identify problems of over-reliance on technology: information overload, privacy and misinformation.
Analyse tourist feedback and reviews and their effect on perception and decisions.

units.title: Domain E: Technology & Tourism

outcomes.text: Analyse how digital marketing is tailored to audience segments and traveller behaviour.
Create a social media page to market a destination in Pakistan.

units.title: Domain F: Future Challenges and Opportunities

outcomes.text: Identify and analyse the challenges facing the tourism industry.
Evaluate economic challenges such as downturns, currency swings and global economy effects on demand.
Predict environmental challenges such as over-tourism, ecological damage and travel's carbon footprint.
